category: Humaniq competes as an HR and payroll administration suite for Dutch employers, from a sole director or small business to a municipality: the employee and contract record, leave and sickness under Dutch law (Gatekeeper Act, statutory and extra-statutory leave), hours, timesheets and rostering, expenses, a table-driven Dutch payroll engine with wage tax and pension filings, performance and compensation cycles, and employee self-service, with a labour-law rule engine checking the records. The buyer compares it with Dutch HR and payroll suites (AFAS, Visma Raet Youforce, HR2day, Loket.nl), with a European HRIS (Personio) and with the open-source HRM a self-hosting buyer would try first (OrangeHRM).
